checks.name: all_headers_exist
command: test -f src/recording/WavWriter.hpp && test -f src/recording/WavWriter.cpp && test -f src/recording/FlacWriter.hpp && test -f src/recording/FlacWriter.cpp && test -f src/recording/RecordingSink.hpp && test -f src/recording/RecordingSink.cpp && test -f src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.hpp && test -f src/recording/OutputPathPolicy.cpp && echo 'All phase D files present'
